purpose: Teach: せり/右下/団員/シャフト/本拠地/在り/ハイライト/ロケーション

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、市場の、本気で、絶対、せり、絶対、見学に行ったよ、メイちゃん、葵で、本気で、絶対、興奮
lines.en: Aoi, I actually went to see the market auctions. I was so excited!
lines.style: Warm and animated, leaning forward. Quick breath before the revelation. Eyes bright. Pace picks up on the excitement—eager to share something she knows matters.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。新メニューの、本気で、絶対、注意書き、絶対、右下に、絶対、書いてあるよ、メイちゃん、葵で
lines.en: Yeah. The new menu details are written in the bottom right corner.
lines.style: Calm, matter-of-fact. Gentle confirmation without making a big deal of it. Practical tone—just sharing information. Eyes soft, attentive to Mei's reaction.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お祭りの団員、絶対、来てくださって、絶対、嬉しいわよね、メイちゃん
lines.en: And Aoi, wasn't it wonderful that the festival group came by?
lines.style: Gentle, inclusive warmth. Reaching toward shared experience. Soft upward inflection on the question. Not seeking reassurance—offering it. A small, genuine smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 彼、ゴルフの、本気で、絶対、シャフト、絶対、新しいの、絶対、買ったって、葵、メイちゃん
lines.en: He bought new golf shafts, actually. He was really excited about it.
lines.style: Light, conversational. A touch of affection underneath. Pace is natural, unhurried. There's a slight smile—the kind you have when sharing something small about someone you care for.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、地域の、絶対、本拠地、絶対、本気で、お洒落
lines.en: The neighborhood hub is really stylish now, don't you think?
lines.style: Genuine appreciation in the voice. Moderate pace, steady. A note of admiration without performative praise. Simple and sincere—inviting agreement without demanding it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 昔、本気で、絶対、在りし日の、絶対、お祖母ちゃん、絶対、思い出すわよ、葵、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、感謝
lines.en: I remember my grandmother used to visit there. Those days feel close right now.
lines.style: Soft and reflective. Slight exhale before the memory surfaces. Slower pace. Tender, not heavy. A trace of gratitude woven through—present tense underneath the past.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 試合の、本気で、絶対、ハイライト、絶対、見てきたわよ、葵、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、興奮
lines.en: I watched the match highlights yesterday. It was thrilling!
lines.style: Bright and engaged. Quick energy on the reveal. Breath of excitement mid-phrase. Open, generous delivery—wanting Aoi to feel her enthusiasm. Genuine joy, no performance.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お洒落な、絶対、ロケーション、絶対、新店舗、絶対、出したいんだ、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、夢
lines.en: You know, I've been thinking—I'd love to open a new location somewhere with that kind of charm and style. That's the dream.
lines.style: Vulnerable openness underneath calm words. Slower pace. Slight breathiness on the dream part—careful, like speaking something tender aloud for the first time. Hopeful, not demanding.
